entries.def:
λαλέω, -ῶ, 
[in LXX chiefly for דּבר pi., also for אמר, etc. ;] 
__1. to utter: of inanimate things, Rev.4.1; 10.4; metaphorically, Heb.11.4; 12.24. 
__2. to talk, speak, say: absol., Mat.9.33; 12.46, Mrk.5.35, Luk.8.49; before ὡς, 1Co.13.11, Rev.13.11; εἰς, 1Co.14.9 ἐκ, Mat.12.34 with accusative of thing(s), Mat.10.19, Mrk.11.32, Jhn.8.30, al.; with dative of person(s), Mat.12.46, Luk.24.6, Rom.7.1, al.; with…

λαλία, -ᾶς, ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly for דָּבָר, דִּבְרָה ;] 
__1. loquacity = Very talkative. 
__2. talk, speech, conversation: Mat.26.73 (cf. Ca 43), Jhn.4.42; 8.43.†
(AS)

λαμά (Heb. מָה, seel. λεμά = Aram. לְמָא) 
why: Mat.27.46 (WH, mg., λεμά TTr., WH, txt., λεμά L), Mrk.15.34 (λεμά LT, λαμμᾶ, Rec.).†
(AS)

λαμβάνω, 
[in LXX chiefly for לקח, also for אחז ,לכד ,נשׂא, etc. ;] 
__1. to take, lay hold of: absol., Mat.26.26, Mrk.14.22; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.5.40; 26.52, al. mult.; with accusative of person(s), Mat.21.35, Mrk.12.3, al.; pleonastic λαβών (M, Pr., 230; Bl., §74, 2), Mat.13.31; 14.19, al.; so also indic., Mrk.7.27, Jhn.19.1, 40 Rev.8.5, al.; metaphorically, with accusative of thing(s), ἀφορμήν,…

Λάμεχ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. לֶמֶךְ), 
Lamech (Gen.5.25): Luk.3.36.† 
(AS)

λαμπάς, -άδος, ἡ
(λάμπω), [in LXX for לַפִּיד ;] 
a torch (frequently fed, like a lamp, with oil): Mat.25.1 ff., Jhn.18.3, Act.20.8, Rev.4.5; 8.10.†
(AS)

λαμπρός, -ά, -όν
(λάμπω), [in LXX: Tob.13.11, Wis.6.12; 17.20, Sir.29.22; 33.13 (Sir.30.25) Sir.31.23, Ep. Je 60 * ;] 
bright, brilliant: ποταμός, Rev.22.1 (ΕΥ, clear); ἀστήρ, Rev.22.16 of clothing, brilliant, splendid: Luk.23.11, Act.10.30, Jas.2.2-3, Rev.15.6; 18.14; 19.8.†
(AS)

λαμπρότης, -ητος, ἡ 
[in LXX: Psa.110.3 (הָדָר), al. ;] 
brightness, brilliancy: τ. ἡλίου, Act.26.13.†
(AS)

λαμπρῶς 
adv., 
splendidly: of sumptuous fare (as freq.; cf. ἐδέσματα λαμπρά, Sir.29.22), Luk.16.19.†
(AS)

λάμπω 
[in LXX for נָגַהּ, etc. ;] 
to shine: Mat.5.15-16; 17.2, Luk.17.24, Act.12.7, 2Co.4.6 (cf. ἐκ-, περι-λάμπω).†
(AS)
